encoding: uint8 row-major, north row first; albedo = min + value/255*(max-min)
orientation: north is negative game Z, east positive X (same as gusev-mola-128)

fit.method: two-point: Viking median -> TES median, Viking 1st percentile -> TES 1st percentile

sources.name: Mars Viking Colorized Global Mosaic (MDIM 1, 925 m)
Mars MGS TES Global Bolometric Albedo Map (7410 m)

notes: Darker means lower albedo: dust swept off by wind and dust devils, showing dark basalt sand. Brighter means more fine red dust. Used to tint the terrain inside the NASA height crop; the invented outer ground ignores it.
